name: spyfall
description: Offline-first Spyfall party game for one shared phone. Persian (RTL) social-deduction PWA in vanilla JavaScript ES modules with zero runtime dependencies, Web Audio cues, Canvas scorecard export, and update-aware service worker caching. Deployed to GitHub Pages via Actions.

paragraphs: An offline-first, single-device social-deduction party game. Pass one phone around the room. Persian (RTL) and English (LTR) UI · zero runtime dependencies · installable on Android and iOS

Spyfall is a social-deduction game: everyone gets the same secret word except the spy, who only gets a hint. Players question each other, then vote on who the spy is. This project runs the whole game on one phone that is handed around, so no accounts, room codes, servers, or internet connection are needed once the page has loaded.
features: Pass-and-play privacy. A hand-off gate names who should hold the phone before any secret is shown, and a floating Cover Mode (حالت پوشش) hides the screen instantly if someone peeks.

Roles and modifiers. Spies (1 to 5), Detective, Fool, known-spy networks, secret side quests, one-word rounds, a question director, sudden death, a last-chance word guess for a caught spy (optional, on by default; a…
Fair tie-breaking. Tied votes are settled by a spinning SVG wheel backed by a crypto-random pick, plus a hidden scoring tie-breaker so shared ranks are rare.
Crash-safe. The match and the exact seconds left on the timer are saved to localStorage. Reload or background the app and you can resume.
